name: Renaissance Learning
situation: An ed-tech platform serving 44 million students daily had no production AI and a 700k-line PHP monolith underneath it.
obstacle: Moderation had to be trustworthy enough for classrooms, and "the output looks better" is not a measurement.
decision: Built a content-moderation agent on a locally fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 inside NestJS, with a real evaluation pipeline (synthetic data, reinforcement learning from eval results, blind grading) while migrating the monolith to Symfony 6 incrementally.
result: 100% accuracy on the moderation filter, under 1% hallucination on domain tasks, integrated across every production agent.
